newsitem.title: USA: Continental to add capacity if AMR pilots strike.
newsitem.headline: Continental to add capacity if AMR pilots strike.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said it is prepared to add flight and staff in key markets if AMR Corp's American Airlines' pilots strike at midnight Friday EST/0500 Saturday GMT.

The Houston-based carrier said it will increase by 100 percent the daily seat capacity on flights between Dallas and New York/Newark; increase by 25 percent the daily seat capacity on non-stop transcontinental flights between New York/Newark and Los Angeles; and increase staffing in certain customer service facilities.
Continental also said it will accept unrestricted fare passenger tickets from American for any available seat in the comparable class of service on Continental for a similar routing between cities.
Passengers with discounted tickets from American, however, may have some restrictions. Continental said it is in talks with American for expanded ticket acceptance policies.

Separately, Continental said it set a special sale fare for travelers on Feb 15, 16 and 17 which allows customers to purchase a 21-day advance fare level ticket to be used for travel on those days. The fare can be applied for one-way or round-trip flights.
